subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin charges in, swinging with his weapon, and manages to strike one of the swarms, dealing a significant blow.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz perks up as Thorin strikes the swarm, scans his spell list, second-guesses his choices, and muses that 'Burning Hands' would have been better or perhaps something with a wider area of effect.

subject: phantom sensation of bugs
